name: Depressive Symptoms
description: Persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or loss of interest in activities that can affect thinking, behavior, and physical well-being.

immediateActions.title: Behavioural Activation: One Small Step
instructions: Think of one very small activity you used to enjoy or that usually gives you a sense of achievement
It could be: making a cup of tea, opening a window, stretching, putting on music, texting a friend
Write this activity down in one sentence
Rate your current mood before starting from 1 to 10
Complete the activity right now without judging the experience
Afterwards, rate your mood again and note even the smallest shift

immediateActions.title: Micro-Action Prompt Sequence
instructions: Sit up or stand up from your current position
Take 3 slow breaths: inhale for 4 counts, exhale for 6 counts
Reach both arms overhead and stretch for 5 seconds
Look around and name 3 things that have a colour you like
Drink a glass of water if one is available
Tell yourself: I am taking one moment at a time

immediateActions.title: Mood Booster: Sensory Pleasures
instructions: Choose one sense to focus on: touch, taste, smell, sound, or sight
For touch: wrap yourself in a soft blanket, hold something warm, or run your hands under warm water
For taste: eat a piece of fruit or your favourite snack slowly, noticing each flavour
For smell: light a candle, open a jar of herbs, or step outside for fresh air
For sound: play a favourite song and listen to it all the way through without multitasking
For sight: look at photos of people or places you care about, or watch the sky for 2 minutes

immediateActions.title: Self-Compassion Letter
instructions: Imagine a dear friend is feeling exactly what you are feeling right now
Write a short letter to that friend with kindness and understanding
Tell them they are not alone, their feelings are valid, and you care about them
Read the letter out loud to yourself
Place your hand on your heart or give yourself a gentle hug
Take a moment to accept the compassion you just offered

immediateActions.title: 5-Minute Gentle Movement
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart if able — lying down stretches are fine too
March gently in place or wiggle your feet for 60 seconds
Roll your shoulders backward 5 times, then forward 5 times
Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side, hold 3 breaths, repeat other side
Finish with 30 seconds of slow, deep breathing with eyes closed
Rate your energy level before and after — even a 0.5 shift matters

safetyGuidance: Depression is a real health condition, not a personal failure, and recovery is absolutely possible with the right support. If you are experiencing persistent low mood, please reach out to a mental health professional or your doctor. If you have thoughts of harming yourself, please contact your local crisis line or emergency services right away. You deserve care and there is help available.
